About Me

My name is Mauricio Palau, and I'm a technical writer based in Mexico 🇲🇽.

I have 10+ years of experience in IT and software engineering, focusing on cloud modernization projects. I create user manuals, API guides, architecture overviews, and process diagrams—often using AI tools to make documentation more efficient.

I started as a software engineer intern, then worked as a systems analyst at Honeywell. It was there that I saw how good documentation can make technology easier to use and adopt, which led me to specialize in technical writing.

Now, at Wizeline, I help clients across IT services, retail, and media deliver AI-driven products and services, supported by clear and practical documentation.
